column1: # THE REPAIR STRIDE -- PO-78's repair phase.  Set at r7329, RE-CUT TO TWO SEATS at r7331.  Data, not code.
# ** THIS IS THE WHOLE LIST AND IT IS NOT A TRIAGE. **  Every one of the 366 REPAIR-OWED rows in
#   corpus/quote_pin_baseline.tsv is on it, in 135 receipts over 67 prefixes.  A row leaves this list by
#   being REPAIRED or by being WITHDRAWN with its case written down beside the repair -- never by
#   reclassification and never by looking hard at it.
# ** THE UNIT IS THE RECEIPT, NOT THE ROW, AND THE BALANCE IS ON RECEIPTS. **  A repair edits a receipt's
#   assertions, so a receipt holding five owed rows is one repair touching five keys.  Median 2 rows a
#   receipt, mean 2.71, max 12; 44 of the 135 receipts hold exactly one.  r7329's first cut balanced on
#   ROWS and came out 74 receipts against 61 -- balancing on the wrong unit, caught in the same cycle.
#   The per-receipt cost is UNMEASURED: the first stride measures it and the measurement replaces the
#   cycle figure in THE_REGISTER's bound rather than being argued against.
# ** TWO SEATS, BY SECONDMENT RATHER THAN A NEW SEAT.  Decided at r7331 on the arithmetic below. **
#   Node 70 is SECONDED to the Lean line's campaign 2 -- the 24-unit reopening -- because that block is
#   the one job on the board designed for a seat with no history in it: 71's interface has the second
#   seat writing a metric's values and partials against a recipe, never reading 71's proofs.  The repair
#   stride is the opposite kind of work: it wants the seat that verdicted the prefix, because the
#   repairer has to recognise what the check was trying to assert.  70 keeps the nightly.
#   Two seats put both fronts on the same horizon as three plus a new seat would have, ~6 cycles, so the
#   secondment costs nothing the arithmetic can see.  ** If the first stride's measured per-receipt cost
#   puts PO-78 past the band's top of 8 cycles, 70 comes back and the Lean block goes single-seat. **
# ** AFFINITY. **  cc66 holds P15_CR_cosmology and its own sector prefixes; 60 holds the L165/L175/L211
#   block it verdicted, plus L147 (the rows cc66's Test 5 clause decided) and the L202/L204 instrument
#   prefixes 70 was carrying.  The tails are assigned to balance receipts and carry no affinity claim.
#   Node 71 is not on this stride -- it has the Lean census.  Node 69 is not a workhorse and takes none.
# ** WHAT A REPAIR IS. **  THE_RULE.md at 1a3c13a61 is the WORKING RULE, adopted at r7329 and refined in
#   use.  A repair makes the check assert what the claim IS rather than that a sentence is present --
#   the form 60 used on its own S45 key at r7330.  Where the rule owes a repair that should not be owed,
#   or misses one it should catch, the case is written down beside the repair and the rule is amended
#   from those cases in small named changes.  The text stays applied throughout.
# ---- cc66: 172 rows in 68 receipts over 34 prefixes
